scope: phase-one formal visual gate only: spawn/front gate -> front hall -> west courtyard -> curved corridor -> repeated-window/moon-gate transition
acceptanceRules: The spawn/front view and front hall must be dominated by the audited Traditional Chinese Siheyuan model rather than BoxGeometry/CylinderGeometry architecture.
The west courtyard, corridor turn and repeated-window/moon-gate approach must be dominated by the audited Ancient Chinese Courtyard Park model rather than TYX_ARCH_Kit_A corridor modules.
The five phase-one screenshots must show a coherent Chinese architectural/garden route with obvious improvement over the old greybox screenshot.
No required shot may be an error/loading modal, missing-texture frame, debug-layout frame, or fallbackArchitecture capture.
Water court, pavilion, north-house and chapter-two expansion are explicitly outside this phase-one acceptance gate.
Visual acceptance is manual and cannot be inferred from build/test success alone.
notes: Run npm run visual:capture after assets:prepare when local command execution is available. The script writes five PNG files and telemetry but never auto-approves them.
25 MiB per-file and 18 MiB preload values are publishing references, not reasons to replace formal architecture with greybox geometry.
